```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample data in long format
df_long = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["NYC", "LA", "NYC", "LA"],
    "temperature": [32, 72, 35, 75]
})

# Reshape from long to wide format
df_wide = df_long.pivot(on="city", index="date", values="temperature")

print(df_wide)
```
